channel.title: PlainBTC
channel.description: Plain-English Bitcoin & crypto news for beginners

item.title: Bitcoin slips below $67,000 as ETF investors pull $1.07 billion in a week
item.description: Bitcoin hit its lowest price since Aug. 19 as spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $1.07 billion this week and fear gauges sank deeper into "extreme fear."

item.title: Indian exchange Unocoin says hackers used its old paper backup keys to take about $200,000 in crypto
item.description: Unocoin says hackers used its own backup keys to drain three hot wallets of about $200,000, getting around a freeze at custody firm BitGo. Customer data may also be exposed.

item.title: Falling prices squeeze crypto treasury firms: Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million, BTCS sells ether to protect a loan
item.description: Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million against its bitcoin and pushed repayment into 2027, while BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep a $64 million Aave loan safe.

item.title: Kraken parent Payward's earnings drop two-thirds from a year ago as crypto trading cools
item.description: Kraken's parent Payward said Q3 adjusted EBITDA fell to $60 million from $178.6 million a year earlier as trading slowed, while funded accounts rose 37% to 7.1 million.

item.title: DOJ, Wall Street and DeFi firms back lawsuit against Illinois' 0.2% crypto tax
item.description: The DOJ, Wall Street's biggest lobby and top DeFi firms back a lawsuit against Illinois' 0.2% tax on crypto trades, transfers and storage. The tax is paused until July 2027.

item.title: DTCC plans to bring tokenized stocks, ETFs and Treasuries to Solana in 2027
item.description: Wall Street's settlement giant DTCC will connect its tokenization service to Solana in the second half of 2027, bringing tokenized stocks, ETFs and Treasuries to the network.

item.title: Bitcoin falls below $70,000 and its 200-week average as traders bet on a Fed rate hike
item.description: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 for the first time since August and dipped under its 200-week average as traders priced in a December Fed rate hike.

item.title: Trump names four SEC and CFTC nominees, including a replacement for crypto advocate Hester Peirce
item.description: Trump nominated two people each to the SEC and CFTC, including Steven Levine to replace crypto advocate Hester Peirce. All four need Senate approval.

item.title: U.S. gets court approval to seize $1.2 billion stolen in the Binance hack and disrupts a North Korean fake video call scheme
item.description: The Justice Department can now seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion stolen in the Binance hack, and the FBI disrupted North Korea's FaceStealer fake video call scheme.

item.title: MSCI will drop Strategy from its indexes as bitcoin slides to its lowest price since August
item.description: MSCI confirmed it will remove Strategy, the largest corporate bitcoin holder, from its global indexes after Nov. 30, as bitcoin slid to its lowest price since August.

item.title: SEC backs the CFTC on stock perpetuals and clears options on more crypto ETFs
item.description: The SEC sided with the CFTC in a court fight over stock perpetual futures and cleared Nasdaq ISE to list options on crypto ETFs that hold assets beyond bitcoin and ether.

item.title: Stablecoin supply shrinks at the fastest pace since 2022 as Tether's USDT loses $6.6 billion
item.description: Stablecoin supply is shrinking at its fastest pace since 2022, with Tether's USDT down $6.6 billion in 60 days. Analysts say that leaves less buying power for bitcoin.

item.title: Hackers hijack crypto bridge Across's website through its domain registrar; about $350,000 drained
item.description: Hackers hijacked crypto bridge Across's website through its domain registrar and drained an estimated $350,000. Across says affected users will be made whole.

item.title: OKX and NYSE owner ICE set Nov. 23 launch for 24/7 tokenized stock trading in the U.S.
item.description: OKX and NYSE owner ICE will open 24/7 trading of tokenized U.S. stocks on Nov. 23, with Coinbase, Circle, Strategy and 59 Direxion ETFs among 70+ assets.

item.title: Bitcoin drops below $73,000 for the first time since August as bond yields jump
item.description: Bitcoin slid to about $72,585 on Tuesday, its lowest since Aug. 20, as Treasury yields jumped and $716 million in crypto bets were liquidated.

item.title: Binance warns iPhone users that an iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet seed phrases
item.description: Binance says a public iOS bug, worse_query, could let malicious apps read wallet seed phrases. No thefts are reported; delete untrusted apps and update.

item.title: Binance blocks MEXC transfers after a U.S. Treasury order over $16.7 billion in alleged illicit flows
item.description: Binance will decline transfers to MEXC and hold deposits from it for review, after a FinCEN order that cuts MEXC off from U.S. firms on Dec. 10.

item.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi and other banks reportedly commit $270 million to a joint dollar stablecoin
item.description: Big banks reportedly committed about $270 million to Project Faro, a joint dollar stablecoin aimed at the first half of 2027 that would compete with Tether and Circle.

item.title: Bitcoin slips toward $73,400 after a hotter-than-expected October inflation report
item.description: October CPI rose 0.4%, above forecasts. Bitcoin dipped to about $73,400 as traders bet on a December Fed hike and ETF outflows continued.

item.title: North Korea is minting meme coins to launder the $6.4 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says
item.description: Elliptic traced stolen Binance funds through six home-made meme tokens on NEAR, while about $2.85 billion of the loot stays frozen.

item.title: Gemini referral bonus: how it works (2026)
item.description: A plain-English reading of Gemini’s official Recruit referral terms as of 2026: the $50-each offer in listed markets, the 30-day qualifying trade, payout timing, and the markets Gemini closed in April 2026.

item.title: River referral bonus: how it works (2026)
item.description: An educational walkthrough of River’s published referral rewards — up to $100 in bitcoin each, in tiers after $100, $1,000, and $10,000 of qualifying bitcoin buys — and the 180-day rules on River’s help center.

item.title: What is a crypto wallet? Custodial vs. self-custody, explained for beginners
item.description: A wallet doesn’t hold coins, it holds keys. Learn the difference between custodial and self-custody wallets, what a recovery phrase is, and how to start safely.

item.title: How much Bitcoin should a beginner buy? A plain-English guide to dollar-cost averaging
item.description: No one can tell you the right amount, but you can pick a sensible way to decide. We explain dollar-cost averaging, test it on real price data, and show how to set up a recurring buy.

item.title: Is Coinbase safe for beginners? What’s protected, what isn’t, and how to lower your risk
item.description: A plain-English safety check of Coinbase: how it stores crypto, what is and isn’t insured, what the 2025 data breach was, and a checklist to protect your account.

item.title: Coinbase wins a full national trust charter from the OCC: what it means
item.description: The OCC approved Coinbase National Trust Company on Nov. 6, putting its institutional crypto custody under federal bank supervision. Here’s what the charter allows.

item.title: FinCEN and the Fed scrap the $250 Travel Rule plan—$3,000 threshold stays
item.description: U.S. regulators withdrew a 2020 proposal to cut cross-border thresholds to $250 and drop crypto-specific wording. Here’s what changed—and what did not.

item.title: Bitcoin loses its 50-week moving average as long liquidations top $1 billion
item.description: BTC closed below ~$75,488 after seven weeks above the line, while CoinGlass logged $1.15B in liquidations. What Galaxy’s checkpoint means next.

item.title: PNC Bank pilots USDC payments with Coinbase for corporate clients
item.description: Eligible corporates can receive USDC on Ethereum via Coinbase Payments, with automatic 1:1 conversion into a PNC dollar deposit.

item.title: Bitcoin’s weekend whipsaw: $1B liquidated as Nvidia headlines hit risk assets
item.description: BTC briefly slipped to ~$73,761 before reclaiming $75,000. Here’s what drove the move, who got liquidated, and what traders are watching next.

item.title: How to buy your first Bitcoin on Coinbase (U.S. beginner guide)
item.description: A step-by-step walkthrough: create an account, verify your identity, add a payment method, place a small first buy, and keep fees and security in mind.

item.title: After the midterms: ETF outflows and a tougher crypto rulebook ahead?
item.description: Spot bitcoin ETFs just posted their largest weekly outflow since June. Markets are pricing regulatory uncertainty as Democrats prepare to lead Congress.

item.title: Bitcoin ETF vs buying bitcoin: which makes sense for a U.S. beginner?
item.description: Spot bitcoin ETFs give price exposure inside a brokerage account. Buying bitcoin gives you the asset itself. Here is how U.S. beginners can compare custody, fees, IRAs, and taxes.

item.title: Coinbase fees explained: spread, Advanced maker/taker, and what a beginner actually pays
item.description: A plain-English breakdown of Coinbase fees: the variable spread on simple buys and sells, Advanced maker/taker tiers, Coinbase One, and how to compare costs on the preview screen.

item.title: How to cash out bitcoin on Coinbase to your bank (U.S. steps, timing, and taxes)
item.description: Step-by-step for U.S. users: sell bitcoin to your Coinbase cash balance, withdraw to a linked bank via ACH or instant cashout, and note the tax reporting basics.
